title: Support JIT-defined package TypeInfo
description: JIT-defined package type metadata is not yet available; do not substitute fabricated metadata.

title: Support package-local globals and initialization
description: Package-local storage and initialization are unavailable. Preinitialization needs loader metadata and managed global references need GC static roots.

title: Implement local finalizer lifetime handling
description: Registration and frontier cleanup are committed and match native on straight-line, branch, loop, interface and mutable stack aliases, failed allocation, exceptions, finalizer ordering and GC. Resume with escaped-address and uncommon exceptional-edge coverage; deep stack-growth failure is tracked separately.

title: Fix JIT stack-overflow crash
description: A 3,000-deep recursive JIT run with a live local alias segfaulted in runtime stack growth while native returned 42. Isolate the trigger and repair stack growth/overflow handling; the 100-deep case matched.

title: Resolve arbitrary external package discovery
description: External package discovery remains unresolved; missing runtime metadata must not be fabricated.

title: Verify auto-environment dispatch and aggregate ABI
description: Interface, class and static interface dispatch have been exercised; auto-environment dispatch and aggregate ABI have not.

title: Investigate nested This in generated CHIR type arguments
description: Source syntax rejects nested This in type arguments; whether generated CHIR can contain it remains unverified.

title: Run main through managed startup without a sidecar
description: The unused sidecar requirement was removed and managed startup runs main.

title: Match native checked-arithmetic exceptions
description: Checked arithmetic uses the native exception factory and exact messages; normal and exceptional cases were exercised.

title: Support typed exceptions and unwinding
description: Standard exception construction, typed catches, cross-frame unwinding and finally paths have been exercised against native execution; JIT-defined exception TypeInfo remains a separate task.

title: Construct and forward native generic TypeInfo
description: Concrete and dynamic TypeInfos, outer generic parameters, nested arrays, tuples and closures are supported. Native/JIT comparisons covered identity and positive/negative type checks.

title: Support native class and interface dispatch
description: Class, interface and static-interface dispatch, including generic introducing types and exceptional calls, were exercised. Auto-environment and aggregate ABI coverage remains separate.

title: Allocate native generic classes
description: Concrete and dynamic class allocations use runtime TypeInfo sizes. Bool and tuple instantiations survived explicit heavy GC in native/JIT comparisons.

title: Push cangjit compiler commits
description: Blocked: GitHub denied SSH identity arthur100500 access to arthur-alekseev-itmo/cangjit.git. Committed compiler work is backed up as ordered patches in unfinished/ and pushed to the knowledge-base repository.
